messages:
Lina (BizDev): quick q — as we onboard more open-model providers, can we standardize a small set of consumer-facing labels/badges for the marketplace and console? e.g. commercial OK, fine-tune allowed, embargo/geoblock, export-risk?
Cheng (Legal): +1. we should keep it short and binary where possible (Allowed / Restricted) and call out nuance in a hover tooltip. also need source-of-truth link to the provider license file or addendum.
Maya (Partnerships): agreed. partners keep asking how we'll surface usage limits to customers. a compact badge makes marketing + sales easier.
Sam (PM): important: these labels must be accessible via API so customers can programmatically filter models. propose fields: `usage_badge`, `fine_tune`, `redistribution`, `export_risk`, `license_url`.
Owen (Ops): can we auto-detect some of this from repo/package metadata? license-scan-bot can pick up SPDX or LICENSE files but not legal addendums. we can add a manual override in partner onboarding flow.
Cheng (Legal): draft badge taxonomy suggestion:
```
Green: commercial & fine-tune allowed
Amber: commercial allowed but redistribution restricted / requires attribution
Red: commercial restricted / non-commercial only or export-limited
```
Also a separate flag for 'KYC required for distribution' if partner needs extra onboarding.
Lina (BizDev): love the Green/Amber/Red. can we add a small icon + 1-line hover copy? e.g., Green -> "commercial + fine-tune ok".
Maya (Partnerships): re: partner comms — we'll need a short script for partner emails and a field in the onboarding sheet that PMs/legal/ops can update.
Sam (PM): UI notes: marketplace card shows badge icon + tooltip. Console model catalog includes a flat metadata row. API returns machine-friendly enum + `license_url`. sample response:
```
{
  "model": "open-rose-13b",
  "usage_badge": "Amber",
  "fine_tune": "allowed",
  "redistribution": "restricted",
  "export_risk": "low",
  "license_url": "https://models.example.com/open-rose-13b/license"
}
```
Owen (Ops): I'll wire license-scan-bot to post a first-pass result in the thread after we ingest a provider. can it post like: `license-scan-bot: scan result — SPDX: Apache-2.0; detected NOTICE with addendum`?
license-scan-bot: scan result for provider/rose-models v1.2 — SPDX: Apache-2.0; found `NOTICE` referencing third-party-attribution; no explicit redistribution addendum detected. confidence: 0.78
Cheng (Legal): thanks — for that confidence <0.9 we need a manual review. Owen, add a mandatory 'legal_review_required' boolean into onboarding flow when scan confidence < 0.9.
Owen (Ops): noted. will add a checkbox and a webhook to notify #legal.
Lina (BizDev): action items: 1) Cheng to provide final taxonomy + tooltip copy 2) Sam to spec API fields + example 3) Owen to add scan + manual override 4) Maya to draft partner email and onboarding sheet updates. target: sync in partner kickoff next Tue.
Maya (Partnerships): I'll prep the partner script and sample contract language for Amber cases.
Cheng (Legal): I'll drop the taxonomy doc and sample tooltip sentences here by EOD.
Sam (PM): I'll PR the API schema and include migration notes for older models.
Owen (Ops): will hook license-scan-bot up to the provider ingestion pipeline and post a sample scan to this thread when ready.
Lina (BizDev): perfect. tagging @here for visibility. :white_check_mark:
